summary: Descartes Systems Group filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its annual meeting of shareholders held June 11, 2026. The meeting covered routine matters: election of nine director nominees (all received majority support), appointment of KPMG as auditors, approval of amendments to the Shareholder Rights Plan, and an advisory say-on-pay vote. Turnout was 86.53% of outstanding shares. No special-situations event is present; this is a standard periodic report of meeting results for a Canadian foreign private issuer on Form 40-F, equivalent to a US Form 8-K filing for annual meeting outcomes. What to watch: none.
